secrets.name: BASE44_APP_ID
secrets.description: Base44 app whose tables, records, media and users are the migration source.

secrets.name: BASE44_ADMIN_TOKEN
secrets.description: Base44 admin token used to read the app's entities, users and media files.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL. Also used as SUPABASE_URL by the migration service.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key: data writes, storage buckets/objects and auth admin calls.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN
secrets.description: Supabase personal access token, used for DDL (tables, RLS policies) via the Management API.
